battle.name: 東歐戰爭
battle.brief: 公元前四十八年羅馬內戰爆發，龐培敗於法薩盧斯，東線空虛，本都王米特里達梯六世乘隙率軍渡博斯普魯斯海峽，侵入色雷斯與馬其頓，欲與龐培會合。他以希臘重步兵方陣為中軍，配色雷斯騎兵與弓手；龐培部將梅特盧斯靠色雷斯輕步兵擾敵、圍城砲火與封鎖海路，於公元前四十七年將他逐回本都。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰方有兩大陣營，加上被捲入的希臘城市與色雷斯部族。龐塔王國方面，國王米特里達梯六世自公元前一百一十年前後執政，前六十年代龐培迫使他接受協議，只保留本都、黑海北岸的博斯普魯斯與科爾喀斯等殘餘地盤。公元前四十八年秋，他調集希臘雇傭重步兵方陣、色雷斯與西徐亞騎兵、卡帕多細亞與阿拉伯的弓馬手，以及王宮近衛，兵分兩路渡黑海海峽，進入色雷斯與馬其頓，企圖與正在東行的龐培會師。命令體系是典型的王朝體制：國王自任總帥，把兵權分給兒子馬查里亞斯等至戚，色雷斯地方首領以附庸名義提供部隊，希臘城市則被強行徵發船隻與糧食。羅馬共和國方面，東線由龐培的部將與元老院委任的總督分節制：駐馬其頓的行政官瑪爾庫斯·佩倫納拒絕歸附米特里達梯而被處死，繼任者蓋烏斯·斯克利博尼烏斯·庫利奧本已奉命入馬其頓，卻被凱撒的使者召回意大利，留下一段真空地帶；真正收拾殘局的是昆圖斯·凱基利烏斯·梅特盧斯，他以元老院與龐培的名義在色雷斯作戰，並依靠奧德里西亞王塞烏提斯三世提供的色雷斯騎兵與輕步兵。羅馬的補充力量來自意大利與亞細亞行省的軍團，後方基地設在拜占庭與佩林圖斯一線的愛琴海沿岸。第三方是馬其頓與色雷斯的希臘城邦與部族：它們夾在兩軍之間，或供糧給龐培一方，或被米特里達梯強行徵用，構成本戰役真正的爭奪對象。
countriesEn: There were two principal belligerents, with the Greek cities and Thracian tribes of the region as the contested ground between them. On the Pontic side, King Mithridates VI had ruled since roughly 110 BC; in the sixties BC Pompey forced him into a settlement that left him only Pontus, the Bosporan kingdom on the northern shore of the Black Sea and Colchis. In the autumn of 48 BC he mustered a Greek mercenary phalanx of heavy infantry, Thracian and Scythian cavalry, Cappadocian and Arab mounted archers and his own palace guard, crossed the straits in two columns and entered Thrace and Macedonia with the intention of joining Pompey, who was moving east. His command system was the classic dynastic one: the king was supreme commander, commands were handed to his sons and close relatives, Thracian chieftains supplied troops as feudatories, and the Greek cities were forced to give up ships and grain. On the Roman side the eastern theatre was divided between Pompey's legates and the propraetors appointed by the Senate: Marcus Perenna, the official left in Macedonia, refused to submit to Mithridates and was put to death; his successor Gaius Scribonius Curio, who had been sent to Macedonia, was recalled to Italy by an envoy of Caesar and left a stretch of empty country behind him; the man who actually closed the business was Quintus Caecilius Metellus, who fought in Thrace in the name of the Senate and of Pompey and relied on the Thracian cavalry and light infantry supplied by Seuthes III, king of the Odrysians. Roman reinforcements came from the legions of Italy and the Asian provinces, and the rear bases were held along the Aegean coast at Byzantium and Perinthus. The third party was the Greek cities and tribes of Macedonia and Thrace: caught between the two armies, they either fed Pompey's side or were squeezed by Mithridates for men and material, and they were the real object of contention in this campaign.
people: 關鍵人物集中在國王與羅馬將領兩端。米特里達梯六世歐帕托爾生於公元前一百三十五年，母親拉奧狄刻出身塞琉古王朝，他靠色雷斯王族的支持奪位，並迎娶色雷斯公主斯特拉托尼刻，這門婚姻使本都與色雷斯維持長久的盟約。他以七十多歲的高齡仍親率軍隊，習慣自乘戰車居中，兩翼以騎兵包抄，兵敗後又能迅速收攏殘兵再戰。他的王子馬查里亞斯率方陣深入，公元前四十八年在馬其頓戰敗陣亡，成為他最痛的打擊。羅馬方面，蓋烏斯·斯克利博尼烏斯·庫利奧是凱撒派往馬其頓的行政官，卻被多米提烏斯·阿赫諾巴爾布斯帶去的凱撒手令調回意大利；龐培本人於公元前四十八年在埃及遇害，東線自此再無統一指揮；真正把米特里達梯擋回去的是昆圖斯·凱基利烏斯·梅特盧斯，他以少數精兵配合色雷斯盟軍游擊與攻城。奧德里西亞王塞烏提斯三世維持對羅馬的效忠，提供色雷斯騎兵與佩爾塔斯特式輕步兵，是羅馬方最可靠的機動兵。尾聲則由米特里達梯的次子馬卡里烏斯寫下：他於公元前四十二年在辛諾波的宙斯神廟刺殺父王，本都王國的最後掙扎就此落幕。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sit at the two ends of the conflict, the king and the Roman commanders. Mithridates VI Eupator was born in 135 BC; his mother Laodice came from the Seleucid house, and he seized the throne with the backing of the Thracian royal house, then married the Thracian princess Stratonice, a match that kept Pontus and Thrace in a long alliance. Even in his seventies he led the army in person, liked to sit in his chariot at the centre of the line with the cavalry on both wings, and could gather his survivors and fight again after a defeat. His son Macharias took the phalanx deep into Macedonia and was killed in a lost battle there in 48 BC, which was the sharpest wound of the campaign. On the Roman side Gaius Scribonius Curio was the official Caesar sent to Macedonia, but an order from Caesar, carried by Domitius Ahenobarbus, called him back to Italy; Pompey himself was killed in Egypt in 48 BC, and the eastern front never had a single commander again; the man who actually pushed Mithridates back was Quintus Caecilius Metellus, who worked with a small body of picked troops and with Thracian allies in harassment and siege. Seuthes III of the Odrysians kept his allegiance to Rome and supplied Thracian cavalry and peltast-style light infantry, the most reliable mobile force on the Roman side. The end of the story was written by Mithridates' own second son Macharius, who stabbed his father in the temple of Jupiter at Sinope in 42 BC, and with that the last effort of the Pontic kingdom came to an end.
kits: 卡面那件希臘重步兵代表方陣裝備的傳統譜系：圓盾「阿斯庇斯」正面覆蓋軀幹，青銅頭盔配護頰與護頸，小腿套上脛甲，長矛配短劍，整套裝備連盾帶槍約二十公斤上下；盾牌接成一線時，整排的防禦力遠高於任何個人。公元前五世紀的希臘城邦把這種兵種推成熟之後，它隨希臘雇傭軍與希臘殖民地擴散到黑海南岸，本都境內的米利翁、基齊庫斯與辛諾波等希臘城市，使米特里達梯的軍隊裡長期維持一支部正統的希臘重步兵方陣；他在前七十一年的澤拉之役就以一萬五千名希臘雇傭重步兵組成方陣作中軍。與方陣並存的是大量色雷斯式輕步兵：佩爾塔斯特用小圓盾與標槍，遊走於方陣側翼消耗敵軍；西徐亞、卡帕多細亞與阿拉伯的弓馬手負責遠程騷擾與追擊；國王自乘戰車居中衝鋒，兩翼以色雷斯與西徐亞騎兵試圖包抄對手翼側。羅馬這邊的正統對應物是軍團：其重投槍與圓盾組合同樣來自希臘，以哈斯塔提、普林西佩斯、特里阿里里三段縱隊構成，士兵靠短劍與重投槍，輔以維利特斯散兵的標槍壓制敵軍前排。攻城方面羅馬遠勝：弩砲、手拉式弩砲、配重投石機、藤籃與防禦帳牆的攻城塔、撞槌與龜甲陣都是東線作戰的常備手段；靠海一面，羅馬以艦隊封鎖本都的穀物與援軍航路。
kitsEn: The hoplite on the card stands for the whole lineage of phalanx equipment: the round aspis shield covering the body from the front, a bronze helmet with cheek pieces and neck guard, greaves on the lower legs, a long spear and a short sword, the whole set of arms and gear weighing roughly twenty kilos; once the shields were locked together the resistance of the whole rank was far greater than that of any single man. The Greek city states of the fifth century BC brought this troop type to maturity, and it then spread with Greek mercenaries and Greek colonies to the southern shore of the Black Sea; the Greek cities inside Pontus itself, such as Miletus, Cyzicus and Sinope, allowed Mithridates to keep a body of orthodox Greek hoplites in his army for a long time, and at Zela in 71 BC he had already formed the centre of his line with fifteen thousand Greek mercenary hoplites. Alongside the phalanx worked a great many Thracian-style light troops: peltasts with small round shields and javelins, moving along the flanks of the phalanx to wear the enemy down; Scythian, Cappadocian and Arab mounted archers for long-range harassment and pursuit; and the king himself charging in his chariot at the centre while the wings of Thracian and Scythian cavalry tried to wrap around the enemy's flanks. The Roman counterpart was the legion, whose pilum and scutum came from the same Greek stock and were arranged in the three-line order of hastati, principes and triarii, the infantry fighting with short sword and heavy javelin while velites and their light javelins kept pressure on the enemy's front rank. In siege work Rome was far ahead: ballistae and cheiroballistae, torsion onagers, assault towers faced with vineae and plutei, battering rams and testudes were the standing kit of the eastern front, and on the seaward side a Roman fleet sealed the grain and reinforcement routes of Pontus.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術主軸是方陣與兵團的正面對撞，再加東歐山地的游擊戰。米特里達梯的打法是希臘化君主的老路：中軍壓上厚重的希臘重步兵方陣，盾牌連成線緩慢推進，兩翼放手大量騎兵，目標不是吃掉敵陣，而是繞到側後破壞羅馬軍團的陣形，國王自乘戰車在陣前巡視，視線可覆蓋整條戰線；早年澤拉與卡比拉的教訓讓他懂得把騎兵分置兩翼而非集中在單側。可是羅馬指揮官吸取教訓，不在開闊地上跟方陣硬碰，而是用色雷斯輕步兵與佩爾塔斯特不斷襲擾方陣側翼與後方，迫使其方陣停頓變形，等方陣被拉出缺口才投入步兵主力，騎兵則集中去切斷敵軍退往渡口的道路。米特里達梯的海陸並行同樣是重點：他用黑海船隊把部隊與糧食一次過送過海峽，落地即戰，不給對手集結的時間；被逐出色雷斯後退回本都，以海路守住黑海北岸，試圖拖長戰事。羅馬的反制手段是圍城與封鎖：以弩砲與投石機削弱城牆後的守軍，用塔車與撞槌處理門戶，派小艇隊切斷本都與外界的往來船隻，並在色雷斯山道設卡攔截潰兵。戰役末期，羅馬主力因凱撒遠征非洲而被抽調，東線只剩有限兵團與色雷斯盟友，這條薄弱的補給線最終決定了戰局轉向。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this war was the head-on collision of phalanx and legion, with the harassment war of the eastern mountains laid over it. Mithridates used the old Hellenistic royal method: a heavy Greek hoplite phalanx pressed into the centre with the shields locked into a line and moving forward slowly, while the wings were given over to a large mass of cavalry whose object was not to eat the enemy line but to swing round behind it and break up the Roman formation, the king riding his chariot in front of the line where he could see the whole front. The lessons of Zela and Cabira had taught him to spread the cavalry on both wings instead of massing it on one side. The Roman commanders had drawn the opposite conclusion: they did not meet the phalanx in the open, but used Thracian light infantry and peltasts to keep worrying the flanks and the rear of the phalanx, forcing it to halt and deform, and only threw in the infantry main body once a gap had been torn in it, while the cavalry was concentrated on cutting the enemy's road back to the crossing. Sea and land in parallel was equally central for Mithridates: he used his Black Sea fleet to carry troops and grain across the straits in one movement, fighting as soon as he landed and giving the enemy no time to assemble; once driven out of Thrace he fell back on Pontus and tried to hold the northern Black Sea by sea in order to stretch the war out. Rome answered with siege and blockade: softening the defenders behind the walls with ballistae and stone-throwers, dealing with the gates with towers and rams, sending light boats to cut the sea traffic between Pontus and the outside world, and setting blockhouses on the Thracian mountain tracks to catch the broken men. Late in the campaign the Roman main force was drawn off by Caesar's expedition to Africa, leaving only a limited number of legions and the Thracian allies on the eastern front, and that thin supply line finally decided the way the war turned.
data: 這場戰爭留下的具體數字不多，而且多半來自更早的戰役記載，要分清哪些有據、哪些只能作概數。米特里達梯六世生於公元前一百三十五年，約在公元前一百一十年前後即位，前四十二年遇刺，統治本都超過半個世紀；公元前四十八年他已七十多歲，仍御駕親征，體力與固執都是關鍵變數。他軍隊的編制在前期戰役有記載：前七十一年澤拉之役，他以一萬五千名希臘雇傭重步兵組成方陣，兩翼騎兵各約四千人，全軍步兵約二萬、騎兵約一萬。公元前四十八至四十七年的東歐戰役沒有同樣詳細的兵力數字，一般只能判斷羅馬在馬其頓與色雷斯的駐軍是數千人量級的精兵，遠少於國王的總兵力，羅馬靠的是盟軍、熟悉地形的色雷斯部隊與技術裝備。羅馬軍團此時約四千八百至六千人，馬里烏斯改革後已改為十個大隊的縱隊；每名士兵每日口糧約一公斤穀物加少量油酒，一個滿編軍團每日耗糧約五噸，因此渡海作戰的後勤比野戰更緊要。地理尺度上，辛諾波到博斯普魯斯海峽沿黑海海岸走約九百至一千公里，羅馬在色雷斯的基地到馬其頓前線約六百公里，步軍每日行軍約二十至三十公里，因此從色雷斯追擊到本都邊境要耗上一整個作戰季。圍城技術參數大致如下：弩砲有效射程約二百至三百米，配重投石機把石彈送出三百米以上，這兩種砲在東線圍城中決定了守軍的傷亡與投降時間。
dataEn: The war left behind few exact figures, and most of them come from the record of earlier campaigns, so it is worth separating what is documented from what can only be given as an approximation. Mithridates VI was born in 135 BC, took the throne around 110 BC and was killed in 42 BC, so he had ruled Pontus for more than half a century; by 48 BC he was over seventy and still campaigned in person, and his stamina and his stubbornness were among the decisive variables. The composition of his army is recorded for the earlier campaigns: at Zela in 71 BC he formed the centre with a phalanx of fifteen thousand Greek mercenary hoplites, put about four thousand cavalry on each wing, and fielded something like twenty thousand foot and ten thousand horse in all. The eastern campaign of 48 to 47 BC has no comparably detailed strength figures, and the safe judgement is that the Roman troops in Macedonia and Thrace were a few thousand picked men, far below the king's total strength; what stood Rome in good stead was its allies, the Thracian troops who knew the ground, and its technical equipment. A Roman legion of this period numbered about four thousand eight hundred to six thousand men and, after the reforms of Marius, was already organised in ten cohorts; each soldier's daily ration was about a kilogram of grain with a little oil and wine, so a full legion consumed roughly five tons of grain a day, which made the logistics of a campaign carried over the sea tighter than those of a land battle. As for distances, the run from Sinope to the Bosporus along the Black Sea coast is about nine hundred to a thousand kilometres, the Roman base in Thrace lies some six hundred kilometres from the Macedonian front, and an infantry column covers twenty to thirty kilometres a day, so pushing the pursuit from Thrace to the Pontic border ate up a whole campaigning season. The siege figures are roughly as follows: the effective range of a ballista was about two hundred to three hundred metres, and a torsion onager could throw its stone beyond three hundred metres; these two machines decided the losses and the moments of surrender of the defenders in the eastern sieges.
cause: 開戰有三重原因疊在一起。第一是王位合法性與失地：公元前六十年代龐培主持的協議只讓米特里達梯保留本都與黑海沿岸的殘餘，比忒里亞、比提尼亞與帕夫拉戈尼亞被收走或交給羅馬的附庸王；他的兒子馬查里亞斯被送交羅馬並在六十年代遭處決，這筆血債他一直記著。第二是羅馬內戰製造的真空：公元前四十九年凱撒越過盧比孔河，龐培帶走意大利的老兵與資財東撤，希臘各省一時要同時供養內戰雙方，龐培據說還私下許諾米特里達梯，只要他出兵西進就支持他奪回比提尼亞，國王於是把這份邀請當成復仇的機會。第三是色雷斯的民族情緒與地緣格局：色雷斯人自米特里達梯五世起就與本都王族通婚結盟，把羅馬人視為壓迫者，米特里達梯六世的色雷斯妻子與整套宮廷關係讓他號召色雷斯騎兵與戰士相對容易；而羅馬在馬其頓的行政官佩倫納被殺、庫利奧被召回，等於宣告那片土地暫時無主。最後是希臘化世界那套以王國作緩衝的邏輯本身出了問題：羅馬容許一個小一點的本都可以存在，卻不允許它重新變成能威脅地中海東岸的強權，米特里達梯要的是回到昔日的鼎盛，不是苟活。
causeEn: Three causes were piled on top of one another. The first was legitimacy and lost territory: the settlement Pompey imposed in the sixties BC left Mithridates only Pontus and the remnant of his Black Sea coast; Bithynia, Paphlagonia and part of the inland were taken away or handed to Roman client kings; and his son Macharias was handed over to Rome and executed in the sixties, a debt of blood the king never forgot. The second was the vacuum made by the Roman civil war: in 49 BC Caesar crossed the Rubicon, Pompey carried the veterans and the wealth of Italy east with him, and the Greek provinces for a time had to feed both sides of the civil war at once; Pompey is said even to have privately promised Mithridates that if he marched west he would support his recovery of Bithynia, and the king took that invitation for his chance at revenge. The third was Thracian sentiment and the shape of the region: since Mithridates V the Thracians had been linked by marriage to the Pontic dynasty and regarded the Romans as oppressors, and the king's Thracian wife and the whole web of his court relations made it comparatively easy for him to call up Thracian riders and warriors; and the killing of Perenna in Macedonia and the recall of Curio announced that the country was for the moment unowned. Underneath all of it lay a defect in the Hellenistic logic of kingdoms as buffers: Rome would tolerate a smaller Pontus, but it would not tolerate that Pontus becoming once more a power able to threaten the eastern Mediterranean, and what Mithridates wanted was the return to the greatness of his father's days, not mere survival.
impact: 直接後果是本都王國再沒有恢復的能力。公元前四十八年米特里達梯贏得了色雷斯與馬其頓的入口，卻輸掉了最重要的東西：他與希臘世界結盟的名聲，以及他用半個世紀經營出來的王朝信用。戰敗之後他退回本都，把希望寄托在羅馬內戰的變數上：公元前四十六年主動靠向元老院對抗凱撒，前四十四年凱撒遇刺後又派大將阿爾凱勞斯進軍比提尼亞，再次被羅馬將領打退。公元前四十二年，米特里達梯在辛諾波的宙斯神廟中被自己的兒子馬卡里烏斯刺殺，本都王國隨即被羅馬肢解，王土分給幾個兒子作附庸，黑海北岸的博斯普魯斯王國與科爾喀斯也先後被收編或降格，龐培時代在東方拼湊起來的體系全面崩解。更長期的影響有三層。第一，羅馬把防線從愛琴海推到黑海：色雷斯的塞烏提斯三世於前四十六年去世，其王國在隨後數年裡被馬爾庫斯·利基尼烏斯·克拉蘇與後來的屋大維逐步吞併，羅馬於是把多瑙河下游的稅收與兵源握在手中，這是羅馬向多瑙河與黑海推進的第一塊跳板。第二，希臘雇傭兵市場被打亂：這支部方陣被米特里達梯在希臘世界招募、被希臘化的龐塔將領指揮、又被羅馬兵團擊破，希臘城邦對雇傭兵的倚賴與本都宮廷對希臘技術的仰賴同時走到盡頭。第三，羅馬內戰的教訓被放大：東線只靠一次成功的違抗中央命令就把整個東方丟掉，讓往後兩百年的羅馬將領明白，行省與邊軍的指揮權必須緊握在執政官與皇帝手中，否則任何一個握兵的外省都可能變成國家的敵人。卡面那件希臘重步兵象徵的方陣戰法，就在這場戰爭裡交出最後一張答卷：盾牌連成的正面能擋住箭與投槍，卻擋不住會繞側的騎兵與會拆後勤的遠征軍。
impactEn: The immediate effect was that the Pontic kingdom never regained the power to recover. In 48 BC Mithridates won the entry to Thrace and Macedonia, and lost the things that mattered most: his standing among the Greek world and the dynastic credit he had built over half a century. After the defeat he fell back on Pontus and put his hopes on the changes in the Roman civil war: in 46 BC he threw in his lot with the Senate against Caesar, and after Caesar's murder in 44 BC he sent his general Archelaus into Bithynia, only to be beaten back once more. In 42 BC Mithridates was stabbed by his own son Macharius in the temple of Jupiter at Sinope, and the kingdom was carved up by Rome: the royal land was handed to several of his sons as client kings, and the Bosporan kingdom and Colchis on the northern Black Sea were in turn absorbed or reduced in rank, so that the system Pompey had pieced together in the east collapsed altogether. Three effects reach further. First, Rome pushed its frontier from the Aegean to the Black Sea: when Seuthes III of Thrace died in 46 BC his kingdom was swallowed over the following years by Marcus Licinius Crassus and later by Octavian, so that Rome took the taxes and the manpower of the lower Danube into its own hand, the first stepping stone on the road to the Danube and the Black Sea. Second, the Greek mercenary market was thrown into disorder: this phalanx had been recruited by Mithridates in the Greek world, commanded by Hellenised Pontic officers and then broken by the Roman legions, and the dependence of the Greek cities on mercenaries and the dependence of the Pontic court on Greek skills both reached their end together. Third, the lesson of the civil war was magnified: the whole eastern theatre had been lost through a single successful disobedience of the central command, and the Roman commanders of the following two centuries learned that command over the provinces and the frontier armies had to be held tight in the hands of the consuls and later the emperors, since any province with troops in it could otherwise turn into an enemy of the state. The phalanx doctrine symbolised by the hoplite on the card handed in its last paper in this war: a front of locked shields can stop arrows and javelins, but it cannot stop cavalry that goes round the side or an invading army that cuts the supplies.
result: 公元前四十八年秋米特里達梯渡海峽而入，到公元前四十七年他已被逐出色雷斯與馬其頓，退回本都，這場東歐戰爭以龐塔王國最後一次大規模進攻的失敗告終。過程可以分三段：頭一年，凱撒麾下的庫利奧被召回意大利、馬其頓行政官佩倫納被處死，米特里達梯的王子馬查里亞斯率方陣深入卻在馬其頓戰死；龐培在埃及遇害後東線再無統一指揮，羅馬的梅特盧斯靠色雷斯盟軍與羅馬精兵接手；第三段是公元前四十七年梅特盧斯在色雷斯的反攻，本都軍被逐回黑海南岸，羅馬重新控制愛琴海北岸的渡口與登陸點。對羅馬而言收穫明確：比提尼亞與帕夫拉戈尼亞落入實控，色雷斯與馬其頓的秩序重建，本都的殘餘國土被視為可以隨時處置的對象，東方再沒有能與羅馬分庭抗禮的希臘化王國。對米特里達梯而言，這是一場只有短暫收穫而沒有戰略成果的戰役：他在色雷斯得到過數月的歡呼與兵源，此後只剩下黑海沿岸的殘土、被處決的兒子的血仇與越來越短的時間。公元前四十四年凱撒遇刺給了他最後的機會，阿爾凱勞斯的比提尼亞遠征再遭失敗；公元前四十二年他在辛諾波被自己的次子刺殺，王位由幾個兒子瓜分，幾年之內本都這個名字便從地圖上消失。回頭看這場戰爭，方陣與兵團的對決在東方已有結論：以國王為中心、把騎兵壓在兩翼的希臘化戰術，面對能快速調動、能分割敵軍、能控制海路的兵團體系，已經沒有勝算。希臘重步兵作為正面無敵的時代，就此在東歐戰場上收場。
resultEn: Mithridates crossed the straits in the autumn of 48 BC, and by 47 BC he had been driven out of Thrace and Macedonia and back into Pontus; the eastern war ended with the failure of the last great offensive of the Pontic kingdom. The course of it falls into three stages. In the first year Caesar's Curio was recalled to Italy and the Macedonian official Perenna was put to death, and Mithridates' son Macharias marched deep into Macedonia with the phalanx only to be killed there in a lost battle; after Pompey was killed in Egypt the eastern front had no single commander, and Rome's Metellus took the business in hand with the Thracian allies and a few Roman picked troops; the third stage was Metellus' counter-stroke in Thrace in 47 BC, which pushed the Pontic army back to the southern Black Sea shore and gave Rome the crossings and landing places of the northern Aegean coast once more. For Rome the harvest was clear: Bithynia and Paphlagonia came under real control, the order of Thrace and Macedonia was rebuilt, the remaining soil of Pontus was treated as something that could be disposed of at any time, and the east no longer held a Hellenistic kingdom that could stand on equal terms with Rome. For Mithridates the campaign brought a few weeks of cheers and recruits in Thrace and no strategic result at all; after it there were only the remnant land on the Black Sea shore, the blood feud of the executed son and a steadily shortening span of time. Caesar's murder in 44 BC gave him his last opening, and Archelaus' expedition into Bithynia failed once more; in 42 BC he was stabbed by his own second son at Sinope, his kingdom was divided among several sons, and within a few years the name of Pontus had disappeared from the map. Looking back, the duel of phalanx and legion had been settled in the east: the Hellenistic method that put the king at the centre and the cavalry on the wings had no chance against a legionary system that could move quickly, cut the enemy apart and control the sea. The age of the hoplite as an invulnerable front ended here, on the battlefields of the east.
